Recorded agent-device snapshots do not expose the framework decor chrome (action bar container/toolbar, status/navigation bar backgrounds) that a live `uiautomator dump` does; those ids are allowlisted as a capture-tool scope difference (fixtures/reference-device/COMPARISON.md).

differences.allow_reason: The phone is 1080x2400 @400dpi = 432x960dp; the ACOS reference session is 1080x2400 @420dpi = 411x914dp. Bounds are compared in dp so that dp-sized children match exactly; this single entry covers the one node whose size is the display itself.

Evidence: fixtures/reference-device/COMPARISON.md ("API 35 vs API 34 ... shift the content origin").
